headline: What Could Push ADSK Stock Higher From Here?
summary: Five years ago, Autodesk spent about $1.8 billion on a string of construction acquisitions. That bet has now compounded into a business generating almost $600 million in annual revenue. This segment is still growing north of 20%, a rate faster than the company average.

headline: Synopsys (SNPS) Stock May Be 24% Below Fair Value On AI Design Tool News
summary: Synopsys stock has had a tough year, with a sharp share price decline sitting alongside a split valuation picture where the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate points to meaningful upside while market multiples suggest the stock is expensive. Over the past 12 months, Synopsys shares have declined 38.7%, which raises the question of whether recent weakness has opened a gap between price and underlying value.
